appearance_facts.fact: A light-yellow wedge occupies the upper-left portion of the circle and is visibly the largest segment.
A red wedge occupies the left side and appears to be the second-largest segment.
An orange-red wedge occupies the bottom and appears smaller than the red and yellow wedges.
A light-orange wedge occupies the right side and appears to be the smallest segment.
The four slices together form a complete circle with no visible gap or legend box.
